data.name: Ecological Carbon Offset Partners
data.description: EP Carbon (Ecological Carbon Offset Partners LLC) is a US-based carbon project developer and technical consultancy founded around 2009-2010, headquartered with offices in Minneapolis and Berkeley. The firm develops nature-based carbon projects (ARR, REDD+, IFM) and operates Carbon Yards, a terrestrial biomass storage product issuing Puro Standard CORCs from engineered aboveground woodchip stockpiles, with its first facility planned in Georgia. Macquarie's Global Carbon invested in the company in 2022.
